SEARCH
Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.core

Class LockFreeAffinityOperations

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.core.LockFreeAffinityOperations
public final class LockFreeAffinityOperations extends Object
Lock-free, high-performance affinity operations for HFT hot paths. Uses thread-local caching and pre-allocated objects to minimize latency.
